title: fix(platform-objects): offer Ban / Unban without the better-auth admin plugin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95zbTp65UwtoUVvRXG2cC9v)_

Fixes #33759

Clause-②: no — offering an existing action in more kernels widens no accepted input set or public export; the dev measures the gaining kernels and the seat amends if the diff reads otherwise
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 用户里的「封禁 / 解封」（`ban_user` / `unban_user`）去掉了 `requiresFeature: 'admin'`，没开 better-auth admin 插件的环境（自托管默认、托管的 Free/Team 环境）现在也会显示这两个按钮；规格里 admin 特性的门禁登记表同步去掉这两项。
- 为什么改：#33227 之后这两个接口不依赖 admin 插件也能用（封禁后会话被 `403 BANNED_USER` 拒绝），但按钮仍要求 admin 插件才显示，管理员在这些环境里看不到停用入口。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示条件，接口、权限（`requiredPermissions`）和按行状态切换的判断都不变；其他 admin 插件专属动作（解锁、建用户、设密码、模拟登录）保持隐藏。回滚即还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（两处删除与块头注释）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`（登记表去掉两项）、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`（新的实跑钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/pending-sso-users.test.ts -t 33759`，预期 3 个用例全绿（未托管、托管两种内核各一次封禁/解封实跑，加一个对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_user.ban_user` and `sys_user.unban_user` drop `requiresFeature: 'admin'`. Their `visible` predicates (the platform-admin standing, then the row's `banned` state) and `requiredPermissions` are unchanged. The admin block header in `sys-user.object.ts` now says which actions keep the admin-plugin gate and why these two do not.
- `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.admin.gatedInputs` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) no longer books the two actions. This is forced, not chosen: `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` holds the registry and the lowered predicates in lockstep in both directions, so a booked input without the gate reds its forward walk.
- Root changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch (the registry edit ships in spec).

## Why

Since #33227 (`cbb876c1`) `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/ban-user` and `unban-user` work on a kernel without the better-auth admin plugin: the ban is written through the data engine and the banned row is refused a session with `403 BANNED_USER`. The two actions were still hidden wherever `features.admin` is off, so a platform admin there had no Deactivate / Reactivate in the console.

### Clause-② reading (measured)

- **Which kernels gain the two actions.** `features.admin` is served as `pluginConfig.admin ?? resolveScimEnabled(pluginConfig)` (`plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`, the `admin:` row of the public features). So every kernel where the admin plugin is not configured on and SCIM is not effective gains them: self-hosted kernels on the default config, and cloud-managed Free / Team environments, where the plugin mounts only with SCIM. Measured in the live pin below: the harness kernel with `plugins.admin: false` serves `features.admin === false` both with `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` unset and set, and the declared actions are offered on both; with `plugins.admin: true` it serves `true`. Kernels with the plugin (or SCIM) on already offered both and see no change.
- **No door or accepted input moves.** The doors were already mounted unconditionally (`auth-plugin.ts`, the `admin/ban-user` / `admin/unban-user` mounts). Nothing server-side reads `visible`: `packages/runtime/src/action-dispatch.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` carry zero `visible` / `features` reads (tree a1fd3723), so the AI / MCP exposure of the two `ai.exposed` actions is the same as before. Only the console's offer changes.
- **The spec export.** `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` keeps its name and declared entry shape; its `admin.gatedInputs` value loses two strings, and since the object is `as const`, its literal tuple type loses two members. Readers of `gatedInputs` in this repository (packages, ui, scripts, apps; tree a1fd3723): `spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts` and `platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts` only, plus a comment in `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts`. `check:api-surface` and `check:generated` are green. Read as not a narrowing of a public export; the seat amends the line if it reads otherwise.

## Tests

- `identity/action-state-visibility.test.ts`, new describe `sys_user Ban / Unban are offered without the admin plugin`: evaluated through `@objectstack/formula`'s `celEngine` on the parsed object, with `features.admin` off on an unmanaged and a managed feature set: Ban is offered on a not-banned row and Unban on a banned one; the standing leg still hides both from a non-admin; CONTROL, exactly `unlock_user`, `create_user`, `set_user_password`, `impersonate_user` still read `features.admin`, and each stays hidden with it off and is offered with it on.
- `plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[#33759] Ban / Unban are offered and work without the admin plugin` in the existing shared harness (a real `AuthManager` behind `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` on a Hono app, `plugins.admin: false`): for an unmanaged and a managed kernel, the DECLARED `ban_user` is offered under the features this kernel serves (`getPublicConfig().features`), its `target` with its `recordIdParam` and `banReason` answers 200, the banned row's next sign-in is `403` with code `BANNED_USER` and no session row, then `unban_user` is offered, answers 200, and sign-in is 200 again. CONTROL: `impersonate_user` is hidden on that kernel and offered on one with the plugin on.
- Forced test edits: `platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts` (the `feature-gate lowering matrix (#2874)` rows for `ban_user` / `unban_user` now pin the bare predicate, since nothing is lowered onto it). `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` needed no edit; its forward rows are derived from the registry.

## Acceptance notes

- First ablation attempt was a no-op and is declared: the anchor (the ban `visible` line) was contained in its own replacement, so `ablation-replace.mjs` refused it (anchor 1 to 1) and restored the file; no run was read from it. The legs below re-anchor on the `visible` / `recordIdParam` pair.
- Not changed, by the card's scope: `unlock_user` keeps `requiresFeature: 'admin'`, though the `set_user_manager` comment calls `admin/unlock-user` a mount registered unconditionally. Whether that door works without the plugin was not measured here.

## Verification

Code and tests are final at a1fd3723; 8631da39 adds only the changeset's `@objectstack/spec` line. Suites and ablations ran on a1fd3723, the derived gates on 8631da39.

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg rebuilt platform-objects and read the built artifact)</summary>

- Leg ban: re-add `requiresFeature: 'admin'` to `ban_user` (ablation-replace, anchor 1 to 0). Built `dist` read: `ban_user.visible = (current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && has(record.banned) && record.banned != true) && features.admin == true`. `action-state-visibility.test.ts`: 2 failed (the offer case and the CONTROL roster). `pending-sso-users.test.ts -t 33759`: 2 failed (unmanaged and managed, `expected false to be true` at the Ban offer), CONTROL green. Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `dist` read shows the bare predicate, both files green (18/18, 3 passed).
- Leg unban: same on `unban_user`. 2 failed in each file, same cases; restored green.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 122 files, 1995 tests passed. Typecheck green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: 277 files, 5488 passed, 10 skipped. Typecheck green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 842 files, 26956 passed, 1 todo. Typecheck green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on 8631da39 derived 88 commands; each was run after a full `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (81/81 tasks) and all 88 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero). Two first-round exit-3 prerequisites were cleared before that round: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` / `check:i18n` needed the full package build. CI-owned families (`pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, dogfood) are read from the PR's check-runs.

</details>

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
